name: Decode Google News RSS Real Publisher URLs for AI RAG (Zero-Key)

parameters.content:
## Google News Real-Publisher URL Decoder for AI RAG (Zero-Key)

Fixes `news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi...` (`AU_yqL...`) wrapper links in AI RAG pipelines using built-in n8n nodes only:
1. Checks legacy plaintext protobuf `CBMi` tokens offline (0 extra HTTP calls).
2. For modern `AU_yqL` tokens, fetches `data-n-a-sg` & `data-n-a-ts` and posts `Fbv4je` to `DotsSplashUi/data/batchexecute` to resolve the canonical publisher URL.

### Optional CLI / MCP / Cloud Batch Options (MIT)
- **Standalone Node 18+ CLI:** https://github.com/truonggiang0111/google-news-url-decoder
- **Python 3.10+ Stdlib CLI/SDK:** https://github.com/truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-python
- **STDIO MCP Server:** `npx -y github:truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-mcp`
- **Free Agensi RAG Skill:** https://www.agensi.io/skills/google-news-real-url-decoder-for-ai-rag
- **Cloud Batch (50–500 URLs + Markdown, $5/mo free tier):** https://apify.com/ttyan0111/google-news-ai-article-extractor
